# Workspace instructions

- This workspace contains mathematical notes and Jupyter notebooks.
- Keep changes focused and preserve the existing organization and notation.
- Preserve mathematical meaning when editing explanations or formulas.
- For Markdown formatting, follow
  `.github/instructions/markdown.instructions.md`.
- Preserve notebook cell order and avoid changing outputs unless needed.
- Validate relevant notebook cells or code when practical, and report
  what you checked.
